messages:
lina (Mkt Ops): Quick sync 1: we should run an April webinar focused on inference safety + compliance for private deployments. Need 3 abstracts, speaker shortlist, and a run-of-show by EOD. Thoughts?
noah (Compliance): Love this. Audience: security/compliance leads + platform engineers. We should include data residency, KMS/HSM, and audit logs.
tara (Product Marketing): I'll draft abstracts. Suggest angles: technical controls, customer case (regulated infra), and exec risk checklist.
sam (Growth): For registrants, add a checkbox for deployment type (hosted/dedicated/private) so we can route leads. utm=inference-safety.
jen (Speaker Ops): Speaker candidates: Noor (Security Eng), Priya (Infra), Clara (Customer - fintech). Backups: Omar, Lena.
lina (Mkt Ops): Draft abstracts from tara: 
- Tech (engineers): "Inference Safety in Private Deployments 1: practical controls you can implement today: KMS integration, audit tracing, and token scoping. Includes config examples and a short demo."
- Ops (platform): "Operationalizing Compliance: SLAs, Logging, and Evidence for Audits" 1: runbook steps and how to prove compliance to auditors.
- Exec (buyers): "Risk & ROI: When to Choose Private vs Hosted for LLMs" 1: decision checklist and cost/effort tradeoffs.
sam (Growth): Those map well to segments. CTA: Register + request compliance checklist. Tag leads based on deployment checkbox and persona.
noah (Compliance): For the demo, record a short sequence showing audit log export + KMS key rotation. Pre-record fallback in case live demo hits policy restrictions.
jen (Speaker Ops): Run-of-show (45m):
- 00:00-00:05 Welcome + agenda (host)
- 00:05-00:18 Technical controls demo (noor/priya)
- 00:18-00:28 Audit & runbook (noah)
- 00:28-00:35 Customer perspective (clara)
- 00:35-00:43 Live Q&A (all)
- 00:43-00:45 Next steps + compliance playbook CTA
lina (Mkt Ops): Rehearsals: pick Tue 10am PT or Wed 4pm PT. recording-bot: scheduled rehearsal reminder will go 48h before.
tara (Product Marketing): I'll write the invite copy + 3 subject lines for A/B. jen: confirm speaker availability and backups.
jen (Speaker Ops): Action items: tara abstracts + invite (today), noor demo clip (Wed), noah runbook slide (Thu), sam lead routing test (Fri).
sam (Growth): Also propose a gated download: "Compliance checklist for LLM deployments" to improve MQL quality.
lina (Mkt Ops): If no objections, we lock this by EOD and start creative. Thanks team.
